information.description:
4-Legged Ground Drone (About the size of a small car). A car-sized four-legged drone, building-bound. Immune to EMP, electrocution and Microwavers. Two leg drills (ROF1 melee, 6d6), magnetic feet that climb metal walls and ceilings, four manipulator arms (Grab, Choke and Throw as BODY 16), a techscanner and techtool, shock-absorbing legs (cyberlegs for falls), LL/IR/UV camera.

Cost: 75,000eb
MOVE: 8
HP: 40
SP: 18
CN: 18
Counter: DV29 E/S Tech, 10 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
